topic: Canada workers benefit (CWB), 2025 tax year: refundable credit for low-income workers; basic amount up to $1,633 (single) / $2,813 (family); family working income must be over $3,000; single basic amount reduced above $26,855 adjusted net income, nil above $37,742 (15% of the excess: $10,887 × 15% = $1,633); up to 50% paid in advance (ACWB); claimed on Schedule 6, line 45300

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): Leo, single, 2025 working income = adjusted net income = $30,000 → $30,000 − $26,855 = $3,145 over; × 15% = $471.75; $1,633 − $471.75 = $1,161.25 basic CWB (disability supplement not included; assumes the basic amount is fully phased in at that income).

spoken.thr: twenty-six thousand eight hundred and fifty-five dollars
spoken.over: three thousand one hundred and forty-five

sources.amounts: canada.ca CRA 'Canada workers benefit – How much you can get' (2025): basic maximum $1,633 single, $2,813 family; single reduced above $26,855, nil above $37,742; family reduced above $30,639, nil above $49,393; disability supplement up to $843
sources.rules: CRA T1-2025 Schedule 6: family working income must be more than $3,000 for the basic CWB; line 45300
sources.advance: canada.ca CRA: if you are entitled to the CWB you will get up to 50% of it in advanced payments (Advanced Canada workers benefit)
